activeSlice.scope: Correct Hunter V1 shadow comparability to measure substantive control work rather than accepted recommendation count. Require real evidence retrieval, at least one measured model invocation, non-degraded Hunter model execution and a positive measured control cost before cost/latency ratio evaluation. Preserve every rollout threshold and production authority guard.
successCriteria: A V1 control with zero accepted recommendations remains comparable when it retrieved non-zero evidence, executed the Hunter model, had no hunter-model degradation and produced a positive measured control cost.
A true no-op V1 control with zero evidence or zero model invocations is rejected before rollout ratio evaluation.
A V1 control with hunter-model degradation is rejected before rollout ratio evaluation.
A V1 control with zero measured cost is rejected because relative cost evidence would be undefined.
Operational cohort construction uses the same substantive comparability predicate during read-only preflight and paired execution.
The existing maxP95LatencyRatio=1.5 and maxAverageCostRatio=1.5 remain unchanged.
The existing minShadowQualityDelta=-0.02, minRetrievalCoverage=0.85, maxFailureRate=0.05, explorationMin=0.08, explorationMax=0.20, maximumTopicShare=0.34 and maxCandidates=6 remain unchanged.
Corrected 3x3 pre-gate passes before any 30-pair full gate.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary, scheduler or production enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
